title: Deployment record and provisioning API for the papyrus product
description: Deployment records as ordinary Virtuus files in the accounts project: deploymentId, accountId, product papyrus, hostnames, status, createdBy, revision, journal. Routes to create, read, list, change and retire a deployment, callable by the Papyrus shared-tier role and by operators with a reviewed grant, idempotent by operation ID. Feeds kanbus-59284c and kanbus-4c99c6. Specs first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-09: the design partner's three new sites launch directly on the shared tier at Papyrus M7, never as dedicated sites. This is required for the partner launch at M7, not a later migration. Priority raised to 1.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Papyrus asks (PPY-966ef5, Papyrus PR #1305): (a) a deployment.changed event; (b) a changed-since list route for deployment records; (c) Prospectus is the only writer of deployment records and hostname claims; (d) the papyrus shared-tier role gets read access plus hostname-change requests only. Papyrus re-reads a record before acting and confirms deletion back. Fold these into the specs.
